verdict.rationale: The only evidence of multi-item action is issuing/distributing shares to 'one or more recipients' at once (vestd-docs-8), which is a narrow bulk-ish operation in one feature area. There's no evidence of broader bulk operations (bulk import, bulk edit, batch API calls) and no API/OpenAPI surface exists (vestd-probe-3 shows 404s), undermining AI-native automation at scale. missing for 10: bulk CRUD across multiple entity types, CSV/batch import tooling, API or webhook support for programmatic bulk actions, independent confirmation of multi-recipient distribution working at scale.
